name: Back Pain
overview: Back Pain is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include area of body discomfort. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: In routine practice, back pain is pain felt in the back.
From a clinical perspective, it may be classified as neck pain (cervical), middle back pain (thoracic), lower back pain (lumbar) or coccydynia based on the segment affected.
From a clinical perspective, the lumbar region is the most commonly affected area.
Health professionals note that an episode of back pain may be acute, subacute or chronic depending on the duration.
In routine practice, the pain may be characterized as a dull ache, shooting or piercing pain or a burning sensation.
